comparison.api_measures: per-record fields spool_count and in_use_count as documented for GET /api/v1/spool/group
comparison.correspondence: endpoint path and field names spool_count and in_use_count document them as counts of spool rows per group, matching COUNT(*) aggregations over the spool table grouped by filament_id
comparison.entity: filament group identified by filament_id, one record per filament_id returned by GET /api/v1/spool/group
comparison.filters: same on both: no time filter; SQL counts all rows in spool per filament_id for spool_count and subset with archived = FALSE for in-use; API is documented to apply the same grouping and in-use definition
comparison.instant: current stored state at query time on both sides
comparison.population: all stored spool rows grouped by filament_id on both sides
comparison.quantity: number of spools and number of in-use spools per filament group
comparison.sql_measures: aggregation per filament_id: COUNT(*) over spool rows for db_spool_count and COUNT of rows with archived = FALSE for db_in_use_count
comparison.visibility: no permission filtering described; both sides see all spools in staging

sql.query: SELECT filament_id, COUNT(*) AS db_spool_count, SUM(CASE WHEN archived = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS db_in_use_count FROM spool GROUP BY filament_id
